Name: Frog Cat Replacement
Author: 1m0ss1
Description:
[i][size=4]Uses content patcher to replace the textures of the ginger cat (cat 1) with a frog.[/size][/i]

If you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] then there is a config built in that allows you to change both the icon in the start menu (when you create a character,  choose farm type, etc) and also disable and re-enable the retexture from inside the game.

[size=3]Requires:[/size]
*[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API
[/url]*[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]*[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10232]Sound Effect Replacement[/url] 

Thank you so much to the people in the Stardew Valley discord for helping me and answering my questions, especially Dots. :)

*Cat 1 = Basic green frog.
*Cat 2 = Blue frog.
*Cat 3 = Red-eyed tree frog.

Downloads.Description: Now has sprites for all 3 cats.
